subject.title: [Bug]: Session transcript mirroring writes header cwd from process.cwd(), allowing cross-agent workspace contamination

question: Should maintainers adopt, rebase, or replace the open closing PR to remove ambient cwd from transcript header creation?
rationale: The fix is narrow and source-reproducible, but the affected metadata crosses session and workspace security boundaries and an open conflicting PR already owns the implementation path.

options.title: Adopt the narrow transcript fix
options.body: Rebase or replace the open closing PR so transcript header creation receives an explicit target workspace and this issue can close after merge.

options.title: Close and replace the stale PR
options.body: Close the conflicting PR only after a narrow replacement path is ready for the same transcript-header cwd fix.

options.title: Defer to broader cwd isolation
options.body: Keep the issue open for a larger runtime cleanup, accepting that transcript headers can still record ambient cwd until then.

recommendation.title: Adopt the narrow transcript fix
recommendation.body: Rebase or replace the open closing PR so transcript header creation receives an explicit target workspace and this issue can close after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The delivery mirror path where this became reachable was landed by steipete, making them the best history-backed routing candidate for the narrow fix decision.
